visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A person opens a dark wood door to reveal an indoor restaurant setting with a black and white checkered ceiling and warm yellow hanging lamps. Inside, a clean Teppanyaki counter is visible, set with white plates, silver cutlery, and wine glasses against a backdrop of modern, minimalist decor. (2) A chef wearing a striped hat and face mask stands behind the counter, using large metal spatulas to flip items on a steaming hot flat grill. He pours a light-colored sauce from a stainless steel pot onto a small, plated appetizer consisting of shrimp and vegetables. (3) The chef presents a large white platter featuring a live lobster, multiple abalones, and fresh green garnishes to the camera. On the grill, lobster halves sizzle under a heavy silver dome, eventually revealing bright red, cooked meat and a cheesy lobster head being lifted by a fork. (4) Cubes of highly marbled wagyu beef are grilled on the flat-top, transitioning from a raw pink to a seared brown as the chef moves them with a spatula. Nearby, slices of cooked meat are picked up with chopsticks, showing off their juicy texture alongside fresh greens and garlic chips. (5) A sequence of diverse dishes is presented: a white bowl with cucumber and seafood salad, a large grilled oyster, a pan-seared scallop topped with orange uni, and a whole abalone. A mini burger with a golden bun is shown before the chef rapidly chops fried rice on the grill. (6) The chef serves a bowl of colorful fried rice topped with fish roe, followed by a close-up of a seafood miso soup. For dessert, two red bean rolls are shown drizzled with golden caramel sauce on a textured black plate. The video ends with a red circular sign for '1975 Teppanyaki'.
